release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CD2087G2H-LIU/SL is an 8MP 4K Smart Hybrid Light mini bullet with ColorVu, LiveGuard active deterrence, strobe, fixed 2.8mm lens and 30m illumination. 2026-07-22: re-verified against the official Hikvision datasheet after issue #138; all specs confirmed including genuine two-way audio (built-in speaker and mic on the /SL variant); added 512 GB microSD max. Retailer source removed. 2026-07-22 (features audit): corrected supplement light range to 40 m per datasheet (was 30 m), replaced unverified 'LiveGuard'/'Super Confocal'/'AcuSense' branding with datasheet wording. Re-sourced to the official Hikvision datasheet/product page (was a reseller mirror).

frigate.notes: Hikvision native RTSP path (main 101 / sub 102); enable RTSP in the web UI.
